Ben — thanks for the quick reply. A bit more color on our side:

- Workload: realtime chat (concurrent agents serving customers) + nightly bulk embedding generation.
- Desired concurrency: 200–350 concurrent inference sessions, plus batch jobs that may push sustained throughput to ~6k tokens/sec during ETL windows.
- Latency target: p95 under 150–200ms for short-chat requests (<=512 tokens). For long-form summary requests we tolerate higher latencies.
- Compliance note: we need VPC/private deployment options and SOC2 evidence during procurement.

We'd like a combined commercial + technical session: 30 minutes for requirements, 30–45 minutes for SE runthrough. Prefer week of Nov 15; mornings Eastern work best.

Anna Morales
